title: Low-Cal Cheesy Mushroom and Potato Bake
subtitle: with Spring Onion Yoghurt
description: Think eating light means eating boring? Not in our book! Our low-cal recipes have all the punchy flavour and excitement you’d expect from us, and just 450 to 599 calories per serve.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Grease a 1L (4 cup) baking dish. Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil for the potato. Thinly slice the unpeeled potatoes. Thinly slice the mushrooms and onion. Thinly slice the spring onion, keeping the white and green parts separate. Finely grate the parmesan.
Cook potato: Cook the potato in the pan of boiling water for 10 mins or until tender. Drain.

Soften mushrooms: Meanwhile, heat 20g butter in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add the mushrooms, white part of the spring onion and 3 tsp pepper and garlic seasoning (see Make it milder) and cook, stirring, for 3-4 mins until the mushrooms are tender. Season with salt, then remove the pan from the heat.

Bake veggie bake: Layer the potato and mushroom mixture in the baking dish, finishing with a layer of potato. Pour over 60ml (¼ cup) milk and scatter over the parmesan. Bake for 15-20 mins until golden.

Serve up: While the bake is in the oven, combine the yoghurt and remaining spring onion in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Divide the mushroom and potato bake among plates and serve with the spring onion yoghurt. Enjoy!
Make it milder: Our pepper and garlic seasoning has a mild peppery kick, so reduce the amount if you prefer less heat.
